# proxmox_guest_move_volume (Resource)

Moves a QEMU or LXC volume through `/nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/move_volume`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_guest_move_volume" "m" {
  type     = "lxc"
  node     = "pve-1"
  vmid     = 200
  volume   = "rootfs"
  storage  = "target"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `storage` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `bwlimit` (Number)
- `delete` (Boolean)
- `digest` (String)
- `target_digest` (String)
- `target_vmid` (Number)
- `target_volume` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `volume` (String) Mount or disk key (`rootfs`, `mp0`, `scsi0`, ...).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
